name: WhatConverts
body:
> Tool · Alphalete · 2026-10-01

# Summary
WhatConverts is the call tracking and dynamic number insertion (DNI) tool on the Alphalete site. It also feeds offline conversions to Google Ads.

# Key facts
- DNI profile **171550**, injected by the mu-plugin `alphalete-tracking-pixels.php` at the client's request. Confirmed by Scott on Jul 31, 2026.
- Swap targets: (720) 807-3224 and (719) 787-7746. Since Aug 17 to 18 the site displays (719) 787-7746 in header, footer and in-body CTAs on all local pages.
- The GHL number pool (Code Snippet #5) stays disabled, so WhatConverts is the only DNI on Alphalete.
- Site tags alongside it: GTM-NN7B5MDM, GA4 G-0E6QYTHXZ3, AW-17950595678, OTTO pixel.

# Issues found
- Alphalete recorded zero Google Ads conversions Sep 4 to 13, 2026 (140 clicks, $1,291.77). Cause: an upload gap plus rejections (one-per-click counting vs gbraid). Check the upload summary first. Parked pending the new Ads owner.
- The "WhatConverts Call Conversion" action recorded 0 conversions in 2026, and there is no swap rule for google/cpc or google/organic. Possible double counting between WhatConverts and the GHL form.

# Rules
- Do not blanket-replace phone numbers on Alphalete; they are tracking numbers. Scott confirms tracked numbers.
